coordinateSpaceNote: path.x/y are key-pitch units: (layoutDip - originDip) / pitchDip. originDip is the min letter-center (x, y) in layout DIP (RootGrid / swipe trail). pitchDip is the median letter-key spacing. Replay: dip = originDip + pitchDip * (x, y). centers lists letter key centers in the same key-pitch space. path.t is milliseconds from the first sample (optional).
